summary: Swiggy's terms outline user responsibilities, platform usage rules, and liability disclaimers for deliveries and payments. Swiggy can modify terms, terminate accounts, or remove content at any time.

clauses.quote: We reserve the right to modify or change these Terms of Use and other Swiggy policies at any time by posting modified documents on the Platform.
clauses.explanation_en: Swiggy can change these rules at any time without asking you.
clauses.explanation_hi: Swiggy bina bataye kabhi bhi ye niyam badal sakta hai.

clauses.quote: Your continued use of the Platform and the Services after any change is posted, constitutes your acceptance of the amended Terms of Use and other Swiggy policies.
clauses.explanation_en: Using the app means you automatically agree to any new rule changes.
clauses.explanation_hi: App use karte rehne ka matlab hai ki aap naye niyamo se sehmat hain.

clauses.quote: Swiggy shall have the right to remove or edit any content that in its sole discretion violates, or is alleged to violate, any applicable law or either the spirit or letter of these Terms of Use.
clauses.explanation_en: Swiggy can delete or edit anything you post if they feel it breaks the rules.
clauses.explanation_hi: Swiggy aapke post kiye content ko hata ya edit sakta hai.

clauses.quote: We reserve the right to suspend or terminate your Swiggy Account and your access to the Services (i) if any information provided during the registration process or thereafter proves to be inaccurate, not current or incomplete;
clauses.explanation_en: Swiggy can ban your account anytime if your details are incorrect.
clauses.explanation_hi: Galat details hone par Swiggy aapka account band kar sakta hai.

clauses.quote: Buyer understands that Swiggy's (including Merchant's and PDP's) liability ends once Order has been delivered to him/her
clauses.explanation_en: Swiggy is not responsible for anything once your order is delivered.
clauses.explanation_hi: Order deliver hone ke baad Swiggy ki koi zimmedari nahi hai.
